audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagree between layers: phases[4].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4] is 'Taliyah' and win[5]/win[6] are 'Aurelion Sol'. On top of that the content layer contradicts itself at level 6 — win[4] says Taliyah but whys[4] describes Aurelion Sol gaining range.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Taliyah x5 then Aurelion Sol x2, matching the content win[] row exactly. The full layer's 'Skill' tokens are stale and the level-6 why was written around an ability Aurelion Sol does not have.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side to 'Taliyah', phases[5].side and phases[6].side to 'Aurelion Sol'. phases[4].why and whys[4] both rewritten so the sentence now argues for Taliyah at 6: Falling Star is 120s at rank 1, while Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth is up every 14s and Weaver's Wall adds roam pressure.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' is used as Aurelion Sol's level-6 spike in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid, and wants.you[3] tells you to 'poke aggressively with R'. spikes[2].text also refers to 'your orbs'.
audit.why: Voice of Light and the orbiting orbs are the pre-rework kit. The current R is Falling Star — 1250 range, 120/110/100s, a stun, not a poke tool — upgrading to The Skies Descend. Level 6 does not hand you poke range; it hands you one self-peel button on a two-minute cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated around Falling Star's 120s cooldown and Weaver's Wall's 180s roam clock; wants.you[3] now says save it as self-peel; spikes[2].text rewritten around the black hole and the beam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent. First, Taliyah's whole kill is Seismic Shove (900 range, 14s at rank 1) throwing you into Unraveled Earth (950 range, 14s flat) — the mines explode and stun only what dashes through or is knocked through. The text gestured at 'the shove into Unraveled Earth' but never said the mines stun, and never gave a number. Second, and better for you: Weaver's Wall cannot cut you off, because Astral Flight flies over terrain.
audit.why: Riot's Astral Flight text is explicit: 'Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction.' Weaver's Wall creates terrain. Her escape and split tool is a road for you and a wall for your team.
audit.corrected: The shove-into-mines chain written into enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and early with real numbers. The fly-over-the-wall interaction written into spikes[1].text and mid.
sources: enemyKit W/E/R text, cds and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] and early both say Worked Ground sets up an 'empowered W knockup'. Worked Ground empowers Threaded Volley (Q), not Seismic Shove.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley on Worked Ground, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that slows enemies.' Seismic Shove has no Worked Ground interaction in the kit.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten — Worked Ground feeds the empowered boulder, and the knockup setup is Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — the field that is supposed to carry cooldowns ended with two joke lines instead.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with Seismic Shove 14s to 8s at 900, Unraveled Earth 14s flat at 950, Threaded Volley falling to 3s at rank 5.

notes:
KIT FLAG MISFIRES IN THIS BRIEF (three of them):
1. ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries terrain='creates terrain'. Riot says Aurelion Sol FLIES OVER terrain. He creates none. Do not let any generated 'your W walls off their dash' line ship.
2. enemyKit Q (Threaded Volley) carries hardCC and grounding flags. Riot's Q text says the empowered boulder SLOWS — there is no stun and no grounding in the description. I wrote slow only.
3. enemyKit W (Seismic Shove) carries grounding. Riot's text says it throws enemies in a chosen direction — a displacement, not a ground. I wrote displacement only.
The missingInteractions headline lists Threaded Volley and Weaver's Wall as things that cancel your channels; that is built on flags 2 and 3 above, so I only wrote the channel-cancel claim in the generic form ('any of her CC ends the beam') rather than naming Q.

BEST FINDING, AND IT IS A POSITIVE ONE: Weaver's Wall creates terrain and Astral Flight flies over terrain. Her signature escape/split tool does not cut Aurelion Sol off. That is straight from Riot's own W text and it was nowhere on the page. It is now in spikes[1].text and mid.

THREE-ROW CHART DISAGREEMENT FIXED: phases[4/5/6].side all read 'Skill' against win[4]='Taliyah', win[5]/win[6]='Aurelion Sol'. packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer, so the full layer moved to match. Level 6 also had an intra-content contradiction — win[4]='Taliyah' with a whys[4] that argued for Aurelion Sol — so whys[4] and phases[4].why were both rewritten to argue for Taliyah, grounded in Falling Star's 120s against Seismic Shove's 14s.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Astral Flight counts as a dash for Unraveled Earth's mines (Riot says the mines trigger on enemies that 'dash through it or are knocked through it', and the ownerKit calls Astral Flight a flight, not a dash). This matters — flying over a live minefield could be free or could be a stun — and nothing in the kits answers it. No text asserts either way. See questionsForUser.
